map.常见宝石与矿物莫氏硬度(Mohs)对照表，列明硬度等级、耐久性与佩戴保养建议，选: Mohs hardness comparison table for common gemstones and minerals, listing hardness grade, durability and wearing/care advice, as a reference for preventing scratches when choosing and wearing jewellery daily.

map.避免硬物混放互相刮花。: Avoid storing hard objects together so they scratch each other.
map.：钻石 10、红蓝宝(刚玉) 9、托帕石 8–8.5、石英 7–7.5、珍珠/珊: : Diamond 10, ruby and sapphire (corundum) 9, topaz 8-8.5, quartz 7-7.5, pearl/coral about 3-4 (organic gems are soft). A hardness difference of at least 2 grades is needed before they noticeably scratch each other.
map.为什么珍珠要单放: Why should pearls be stored separately?
map.：珍珠硬度仅 3–4，与金属或硬石同盒会被划伤；应软布分隔存放，远离 7 级以上: : Pearls have a hardness of only 3-4 and are scratched if boxed with metal or hard stones; store them separated by soft cloth and away from gemstones of grade 7 and above.
map.不是等比。10 级是 ordinal 排序，钻石(10)远超刚玉(9)的差距远大: No, it is not a geometric progression. Grade 10 is an ordinal ranking; the gap from corundum (9) to diamond (10) is far larger than that between 9 and 8, and it only indicates whether one can scratch the other.

map.每种宝石维护可核验的硬度区间（如祖母绿 7.5–8、石榴石 6.5–7.5、珍珠: Each gem keeps a verifiable hardness range (emerald 7.5–8, garnet 6.5–7.5, pearl 2.5–4.5, for example), and filtering checks whether ranges overlap. The 8–9 preset includes both corundum at 9 and spinel at 7.5–8. Copy and Export current filter CSV both use the current search/filter and output the full fields.
map.：钻石 10、红蓝宝(刚玉) 9、托帕石 8、尖晶石 7.5–8、祖母绿 7.5: : Diamond 10, ruby/sapphire (corundum) 9, topaz 8, spinel 7.5–8, emerald 7.5–8, quartz 7, garnet 6.5–7.5, pearl 2.5–4.5. The page matches by overlap between the gem's range and the filter range, not by a single representative value.
map.莫氏硬度是排序而非等比，硬度高也可能因解理或脆性碎裂；表中区间为常见值，产地、优: Mohs hardness is an ordinal scale, not a geometric one; a hard stone can still chip because of cleavage or brittleness. Ranges are common values; origin, treatment and individual stones can vary.
map.筛选 8–9 为什么包含尖晶石？: Why does the 8–9 filter include spinel?
map.尖晶石常见硬度约 7.5–8，与 8–9 区间在 8 处有交集，因此会纳入；刚玉: Spinel commonly falls around 7.5–8, which overlaps 8–9 at 8, so it is included; corundum at 9 is also inside. Choose the “9” filter if you want only grade 9.
map.硬度高就不怕摔吗？: Does high hardness mean it will not break?
map.不是。莫氏硬度只代表抗刮擦（划痕）能力，不代表韧性（抗碎裂）。钻石硬度 10 但: No. Mohs hardness only describes scratch resistance, not toughness. Diamond is 10 but has perfect cleavage and can split along cleavage planes under a sharp blow; jadeite is only 6.5–7 but very tough and resistant to impact; fluorite is 4 yet brittle. For daily wear, toughness matters too: emerald is 7.5–8 but brittle and fractured, so avoid ultrasonic cleaning and knocks.
